steps.name: Freya's Hildisvini (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Freya] in the "Isolation Room", then defeat [Red Hildisvini] in "Moros" to obtain [Freya's Red Hildisvini]. Report to [Freya] in "Isolation Room 2" afterward.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: The disobedient machines in the hydroponic farm aren't enough. I need something more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a bad feeling about this...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahaha! You're here? Wonderful! Welcome! I'm so, so happy to see you!!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Sob... I've missed you so much, and you never visited. Did you know it's been almost ten years?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Ten years? I'm not falling for that.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Tch. You won't even humor a tragic heroine. I'm hurt. Nyahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard you wanted to see me.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: You only visit Sarasvati these days. You never come to see me, so I'm sulking. Hmph!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Besides, I'm bored. If I ever die, it'll probably be from boredom!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You sound just like someone I know...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hmph?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's someone like that.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Oh, so there's someone like me. Anyway, I'm so boooored. Being stuck in this dull place with Warsam and Kerberus is so tiiiiresome.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Soooo...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, please stop dragging out your words. I'm begging you. It's draining all my energy...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehe! Anyway, I have a favor to ask! Sarasvati told me you recently visited a place full of wonderful pigs!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Well, actually, I just happened to sneak a look at her protocol...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Freya, I didn't realize how frightening you were...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Ahaha♡ I'm not a person, though. Thanks for treating me like one!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. Anyway, what about the wild boars in Moros?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Catch them and bring them to me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Pigs are my friends!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? I don't understand at all!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehe. No more and no less than thirty of the wild boars roaming around that area, please♡

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: They'll make this hydroponic farm much more fun!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Won't Kerberus and Warsam object?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: It's fine! If they don't listen, I'll rip out all their circuits!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I'll tell you why when you get back. You'll understand once you hear it, Adventurer! Nyaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I'm suspicious, but I'll go. You'd better explain properly!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I promise! Hurry back!

steps.name: Freya's Hildisvini (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Blue Hildisvini] and [Purple Hildisvini] in "Dreaming Oneiro" and obtain [Freya's Blue Hildisvini] and [Freya's Purple Hildisvini]. Then report to [Freya] in "Isolation Room 2".

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yay! You're here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What exactly are you planning to do with all these wild boars?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You hand Freya several of the Hildisvinis you caught.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehe, hehe. Such beautiful, magnificent wild boars!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: You know me, right? I'm your mistress!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Right, I'll give you new names! I've forgotten all the old ones.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: You're Goldie, you're %s, and you're Numbskull...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I heard my name in there...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Tch. %s was such a good name for a boar... I almost got away with it... (Mumble, mumble.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now tell me why you wanted the boars, like you promised.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Not enough. There aren't enough pigs...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: There aren't enough piiigs.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? You mean...?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I need the ones in other cooolors. Aww.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want me to catch more wild boars?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Bingo! That's our %s! Bring me the other two kinds of boars in different colors, and I'll give you my autograph!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't need your autograph. Just tell me why.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I'll tell you a story even Sarasvati doesn't know! How's that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. I'm still suspicious...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: If you don't want to, I can't make yooou. Teehee.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go. But promise me this is the last time.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehe, I promise. Nyahaha.

steps.name: Freya's Hildisvini (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Freya] in "Isolation Room 2", then find [Ishtar] in "Isolation Room 1".

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yay! You're back again!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forty wild boars, as promised... Here you go.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Good work! Nyahaha.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: This should be enough for the little ones to live comfortably here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will you tell me now, as promised?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: A promise is a promise, so I'll tell you!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: These little ones originally came with the people of Asgard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: We raised them as a kind of emergency food supply.
(The Hildisvini in front of Freya goes stiff.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahaha! Don't be scared! There aren't any humans here to eat you anyw... Oh, there's one right here.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: A hole opened in the ship, and whoosh! The pigs went flying out into space... I thought that was the last I'd ever see of them.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: But! Wahahaha! How much time has passed? Their children's children's children...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, these are their descendants?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: No! I thought they were their children's children's children's... Well, their descendants. But they're the very same pigs!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The same pigs from back then?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yep! At first, I just thought I'd raise some pigs. But when I looked closer, it really was one of my old little ones! We parted so long ago. How could they be unchanged?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Look how nice and plump they've gotten! I'll raise lots of them and...
(The Hildisvini in front of Freya looks extremely nervous.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Raise lots of them and ride them around the hydroponic farm! Nyah♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Freya, I'm leaving.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Say hello to Big Sis Ishtar on the way out. I think she has something to tell you. Nyaha! Stop right there, you pigs!! I'll catch you all and teach you a lesson☆

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: It's been a while. You've been very busy lately, haven't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. A lot has happened.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Sarasvati gave me a rough idea of what happened. We may be involved somehow, yet I haven't paid enough attention.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I appreciate the thought.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: We'll do more to help you from now on. I promise.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: This matters both to you and to us. It may even reveal the truth of this world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's reassuring.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Give my regards to that girl, too. The one you searched so hard for, who can save this world...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Ah, I suppose she's this planet's goddess now.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Anyway, keep doing the things only you can do. We'll find our own ways to help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Oh, all right. It's been a while, but you seem to have gotten rather impatient... Leaving already.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Ahahaha! Catch me if you can! You pigs, why do you keep running away? Nyahaha!♡

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I'll assume the desire to avoid that sight is why you left so soon. Ugh. I wonder if any records of the Galactic War remain...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahaha!♡

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: (Freya races wildly around, trying to catch the Hildisvinis.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: It's distracting, but it's been a long time since Freya was this lively. I'll leave her be.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahaha!♡ Let's never be separated again, meow!
